title: Enterprise Network Lab
tagline: A segmented enterprise network built by hand: pfSense, VLANs, a DMZ, Suricata, then real attacks against it. It grows one lab at a time.
description: Live build log of a virtualized enterprise network: pfSense firewall, VLAN-aware switch, DMZ with Nginx and Squid, Suricata IDS, and attack simulations, synced from GitHub.

title: AI Pentest Agent
tagline: An agentic recon & footprinting assistant for authorized labs. A local LLM advises, rules decide, and every command runs in a locked-down Kali container. Below: a replay of a real run from the repo's test fixtures.
description: Live build log of an AI-assisted recon and footprinting agent for authorized pentesting: rule-based planner, local LLM advisor, sandboxed Kali container, approval-gated exploit validation.

title: Web API Attack Detection with AI
tagline: Rules, Coraza + OWASP CRS and two machine-learning models, fused into one risk score. The stream below replays real requests from the project's dataset.
description: Live build log of a hybrid web API attack detector: custom rules, Coraza + OWASP CRS, a payload classifier and an Isolation Forest behavior model fused with a noisy-OR.
